mapper.select: SELECT id,rule_code rule_code,alert_instance_id alert_instance_id,notify_channel channel,retry_count attempts,dead_letter_status dead_letter_status,last_http_status http_status,last_provider_code provider_code,last_error_type error_type,last_error_summary error_summary,dead_lettered_at dead_lettered_at,manual_replay_count replay_count FROM t_alert_notification WHERE ORDER BY dead_lettered_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id,rule_id rule_id,rule_code rule_code,alert_instance_id alert_instance_id,notify_channel channel,notify_status status,retry_count attempts,max_retries max_retries,dead_letter_status dead_letter_status,dead_lettered_at dead_lettered_at,provider_message_id provider_message_id,last_http_status http_status,last_provider_code provider_code,last_error_type error_type,last_error_summary error_summary,manual_replay_count replay_count,created_at created_at,updated_at updated_at FROM t_alert_notification WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='NOTIFICATION'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alert_notification SET notify_status='PENDING',retry_count=0,next_attempt_at=NOW(3),dead_letter_status='REPLAYED',manual_replay_count=manual_replay_count+1,last_error_type=NULL,last_error_summary=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND notify_status='DEAD_LETTER' AND dead_letter_status IN ('OPEN','IGNORED')
UPDATE t_alert_notification SET dead_letter_status='IGNORED' WHERE id=#{id} AND notify_status='DEAD_LETTER' AND dead_letter_status='OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_alert_notification WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type='NOTIFICATION'
